goal: Prevent one automatic lifecycle client's transient or unsafe panel error from persistently stopping client creation across the fleet; restore and verify classified Output with all existing ownership/outcome safeguards.
context: Confirmed incident: per-panel Sanaei circuit retry30s escaped RunOne durable retry and main.go closed global gate indefinitely. Implement durable per-panel COOLDOWN and QUARANTINED state with additive migration161. For lifecycle jobs only, known pre-mutation runtime API/circuit unavailability gets bounded30..120s durable cooldown, returns jobPENDING and cancels only the claim attempt (record separate deferral counter; do not refund or reset finite scope budgets). Claim excludes cooling/quarantined panels so healthy work continues. Known remote mutation/verification failure keeps original read-before-retry with bounded attempts; exhausted/conflicting outcomes become FAILED plus panelQUARANTINED atomically, never auto reopened. Other internal/DB/invariant errors still globally fail-close with persistent safe reason/panel/job. Preserve old explicit canary error behavior. Avoid broad error swallowing; errors.Is typed known remote/lifecycle sentinels only. Success can clear only COOLDOWN, never quarantine. Admission refuses blocked panels; existing policy/cleanup/expired ownership guards remain unchanged. Expose automation state and per-panel cooldown/quarantine counts in authenticated Configs/Output UI; public plain subscription format remains URI-only and no private error details leak. Implement through canonical source, isolated realPostgres fault/race/full Go tests, OpenAI source review, clean build/rollback deployment, then existing authenticated capacity resume with user authorization; no raw gate rewrite, admin impersonation, blind failedjob retry or test cloud resources. Record native API-derived generated clients and actual class share bodies over replacement cycle; refresh checkpoints. Main implementer with server OpenAI plan/review.
